metadata.title: Boundary fibers of the holonomy map for complex projective structures
metadata.abstract: We study the Morgan--Shalen boundary of holonomy representations of complex projective structures on a compact Riemann surface of genus at least two. We prove that every direction defined by a holomorphic quadratic differential with a multiple zero admits distinct projective marked length limits. Together with Dumas's uniqueness theorem for simple zeros, this gives a complete characterization of directions with unique limits. We also establish that no nonzero abelian length function can occur in the holonomy boundary of any such fixed surface, regardless of the limiting quadratic differential. Finally, we characterize all directional boundary fibers by a necessary-and-sufficient analytic condition involving valued representations and the holomorphic jet bundle underlying an oper.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 边界纤维与长度极限分类
analysis.workSummary: 对固定亏格≥2紧黎曼曲面上的复射影结构，研究其holonomy表示的Morgan–Shalen边界。每个具有多重零点的全纯二次微分方向都有不同的射影标记长度极限，结合Dumas简单零点唯一性，完整刻画方向极限唯一的情形。任意该固定曲面的holonomy边界都不含非零阿贝尔长度函数；又以赋值表示和oper底层全纯jet丛的必要充分解析条件刻画所有方向边界纤维。
analysis.breakthrough: 把二次微分多重零点同边界非唯一性精确关联，并给方向纤维的解析充要刻画。
analysis.limitations: 曲面固定且亏格≥2；不同射影长度极限不是单纯不同表示的重命名。排除非零阿贝尔长度函数不等于排除所有R树作用。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
